title: 10. Exercises: Performance Optimization
summary: Implement request coalescing for duplicate concurrent requests.
objectives: Solve the Performance Optimization exercises without looking at the lesson
Test edge cases and explain your approach

sections.title: Exercises
sections.body:
### Exercise 1: Benchmark Suite

Create comprehensive benchmark suite for concurrent code.

### Exercise 2: Memory Profiler

Create async memory profiler with leak detection.

### Exercise 3: Latency Histogram

Create latency histogram visualization for async tasks.

### Exercise 4: Auto-Tuning Pool

Create pool that automatically adjusts worker count.

### Exercise 5: Request Coalescing

Implement request coalescing for duplicate concurrent requests.

### Exercise 6: Adaptive Batching

Create batching that adjusts batch size based on load.

### Exercise 7: Connection Pool Monitor

Create monitor for connection pool utilization.

### Exercise 8: Throughput Controller

Create throughput controller with PID algorithm.

### Exercise 9: Async Profiler

Create profiler specifically for async code.

### Exercise 10: Performance Dashboard

Create real-time performance dashboard for concurrent app.

**Next: [17_debugging.md](./17_debugging.md)** — Learn to debug concurrent code →
